title: HealthHiderPacket
description: Hides player health from other players to prevent ESP and unfair advantages in PvP.
body:
**sHealthHiderPacket** - is a lightweight anti-cheat plugin designed to protect fair PvP gameplay.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You must install ProtocolLib on the server for the plugin to work properly!

The plugin hides player health information from other players by intercepting and filtering `ENTITY_METADATA` packets using ProtocolLib. This prevents cheats such as ESP, health indicators, and other unfair tools from accessing real-time health data.

Perfect for PvP servers where competitive integrity matters.

**Features:**

- Hides player health from other players
- Blocks ESP and health-based cheats
- Works via ProtocolLib packet filtering
- Lightweight and optimized
- Fully configurable

Notice the health bar this is the player's real HP, it is not fixed or faked.
![Legit](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50050475b5265f3dadf0d8820c353bcf321363b7_0.webp)

ESP always shows 20 HP regardless of the player's actual health real data is hidden.
![Cheats](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5d67e31cc6a96ff04d509edb2d841f18ae124d0.png)
